title: BALLSTREET DAO
tagline: BALLSTREET is the place where the people with the best cards in the world go to list their cards. BALLSTREET’s unique DAO structure gives you the power to be rewarded in tokens for contributing to the success of BALLSTREET any way you can. The opportunities are endless.
description:
BALLSTREET is the place where the people with the best cards in the world go to list their cards.



BALLSTREET is a token-based platform that makes it easy to purchase hard-to-find and sought-after sports cards. BALLSTREET allows people to invest in their favorite athletes' sports cards through an easy-to-use platform. Users can buy, sell, or hold tokens on the BALLSTREET marketplace. Unlike other NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens), BALLSTREET collectibles are fully represented by a real-world physical asset which is safely stored in a vault.



BALLSTREET is all about community. We’re inviting you to take ownership of BALLSTREET and join the DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization).



To learn more, please visit our website:

https://ballstreet.webflow.io/daohacks
how_its_made:
https://github.com/BallStreetCards/daohack/blob/master/README.md



Using a top-level DAO to control creation of subDAOs for each minted card. 



OpenZeppelin for most smart contracts, Quasar for front-end, node-js and Firebase backend. TypeScript everywhere where possible. Currently we have a few places that need TLC and the subDAO contract details is something to be implemented in the future, but the PoC is there.
